parameters.help_en:
The instance-level namespace regex filter.
This parameter takes effect only when SyncScope is set to `INSTANCE`
parameters.help_zh:
实例级别命名空间正则
该参数仅在同步类型 SyncScope 是 `INSTANCE` 时有效

parameters.help_en:
The repository filter rule.
This parameter takes effect only when SyncScope is set to `INSTANCE` or `NAMESPACE`
parameters.help_zh:
仓库过滤规则。
该参数仅在同步类型 SyncScope 是 `INSTANCE` 或 `NAMESPACE` 时有效
parameters.name: repo_name_filter

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization type. Valid values:

`REPO`: Synchronizes by image repository.

`NAMESPACE`: Synchronizes by namespace.

`INSTANCE`: Synchronizes by namespace regex and repository regex
parameters.help_zh:
同步类型，取值：

`REPO`：按照镜像仓库同步。

`NAMESPACE`：按照命名空间同步。

`INSTANCE`：按照命名空间正则和仓库正则同步
parameters.name: sync_scope

parameters.help_en: The name of the synchronization rule
parameters.name: sync_rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The trigger for the synchronization action. Valid values:

`INITIATIVE`: Manual trigger.
 
`PASSIVE`: Automatic trigger
parameters.help_zh:
触发同步动作，取值：

`INITIATIVE`：手动触发。
 
`PASSIVE`：自动触发
parameters.name: sync_trigger

parameters.help_en:
The UID of the account to which the target instance belongs.

This parameter is required for cross-account image synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例所在的账号UID。

跨账号同步镜像时，需要使用账号UID
parameters.name: target_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom synchronization link
parameters.name: link_id

parameters.help_en:
The execution priority of the synchronization task. Synchronization tasks are executed in descending order of priority. Tasks with the same priority are executed in random order.

Valid values: 1 to 5.

Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh:
同步任务执行优先级。同步任务按照该优先级从大到小的顺序被执行。相同优先级的同步任务按随机顺序执行。

取值范围：1～5

默认值：3
parameters.name: priority
